    if(wrap){
        var isDown = false, startX, scrollLeft;
        wrap.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e){
            isDown = true; wrap.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
            startX = e.pageX - wrap.offsetLeft;
            scrollLeft = wrap.scrollLeft;
        });
        wrap.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(){ isDown = false; wrap.style.cursor = 'grab'; });
        wrap.addEventListener('mouseup', function(){ isDown = false; wrap.style.cursor = 'grab'; });
        wrap.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
            if(!isDown) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            var x = e.pageX - wrap.offsetLeft;
            wrap.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - (x - startX);
        });
    }

    // 3. Search autocomplete
    var searchInput = document.getElementById('s');
    if(searchInput){
        var acBox = document.createElement('div');
        acBox.id = 'search-autocomplete';
        acBox.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:12px;margin-top:4px;max-height:300px;overflow-y:auto;display:none;z-index:10000;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12);';
        searchInput.parentElement.style.position = 'relative';
        searchInput.parentElement.appendChild(acBox);

        var acTimer = null;
        searchInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
            clearTimeout(acTimer);
            var q = this.value.trim();
            if(q.length < 2){ acBox.style.display='none'; return; }
            acTimer = setTimeout(function(){
                var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhr.open('GET', '/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?search=' + encodeURIComponent(q) + '&per_page=6&_fields=id,title,link');
                xhr.onload = function(){
                    if(xhr.status === 200){
                        var posts = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                        if(posts.length === 0){ acBox.style.display='none'; return; }
                        var html = '';
                        posts.forEach(function(p){
                            html += '<a href="'+p.link+'" style="display:block;padding:10px 16px;color:#1e293b;text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;transition:background .2s;" onmouseover="this.style.background=\'#f0f9ff\'" onmouseout="this.style.background=\'#fff\'">' + p.title.rendered + '</a>';
                        });
                        acBox.innerHTML = html;
                        acBox.style.display = 'block';
                    }
                };
                xhr.send();
            }, 300);
        });

            if(!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !acBox.contains(e.target)){

            }
        });

(function(){
    // 1. Sticky nav position
    var h = document.getElementById('header');
    var n = document.getElementById('main-nav');
    if(h && n){
        function setNav(){ n.style.top = h.offsetHeight + 'px'; }
        setNav();
        window.addEventListener('resize', setNav);
    }

    // 2. Drag-to-scroll for nav menu
    var wrap = n ? n.querySelector('.wrap') : null;
    if(wrap){
        var isDown = false, startX, scrollLeft;
        wrap.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e){
            isDown = true; wrap.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
            startX = e.pageX - wrap.offsetLeft;
            scrollLeft = wrap.scrollLeft;
        });
        wrap.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(){ isDown = false; wrap.style.cursor = 'grab'; });
        wrap.addEventListener('mouseup', function(){ isDown = false; wrap.style.cursor = 'grab'; });
        wrap.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
            if(!isDown) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            var x = e.pageX - wrap.offsetLeft;
            wrap.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - (x - startX);
        });
    }

    // 3. Search autocomplete
    var searchInput = document.getElementById('s');
    if(searchInput){
        var acBox = document.createElement('div');
        acBox.id = 'search-autocomplete';
        acBox.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:12px;margin-top:4px;max-height:300px;overflow-y:auto;display:none;z-index:10000;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12);';
        searchInput.parentElement.style.position = 'relative';
        searchInput.parentElement.appendChild(acBox);

        var acTimer = null;
        searchInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
            clearTimeout(acTimer);
            var q = this.value.trim();
            if(q.length < 2){ acBox.style.display='none'; return; }
            acTimer = setTimeout(function(){
                var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhr.open('GET', '/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?search=' + encodeURIComponent(q) + '&per_page=6&_fields=id,title,link');
                xhr.onload = function(){
                    if(xhr.status === 200){
                        var posts = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                        if(posts.length === 0){ acBox.style.display='none'; return; }
                        var html = '';
                        posts.forEach(function(p){
                            html += '<a href="'+p.link+'" style="display:block;padding:10px 16px;color:#1e293b;text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;transition:background .2s;" onmouseover="this.style.background=\'#f0f9ff\'" onmouseout="this.style.background=\'#fff\'">' + p.title.rendered + '</a>';
                        });
                        acBox.innerHTML = html;
                        acBox.style.display = 'block';
                    }
                };
                xhr.send();
            }, 300);
        });
        document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
            if(!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !acBox.contains(e.target)){
                acBox.style.display = 'none';
            }
        });
    }
})();
</script>
